sections.Intro: This remedy is indicated in cases of urinary disorders, especially those related to the kidneys. It is useful in cases of dropsy and albuminuria. There is a general feeling of heaviness and soreness in the renal region. It is also useful in cases of gout and rheumatism.
sections.Head: Headache, with a sensation of weight in the forehead. Vertigo.
sections.Stomach: Appetite poor. Nausea. Burning in the stomach.
sections.Urinary: Scanty, dark, and foul-smelling urine. Albuminuria. Burning in the urethra. Stones in the kidneys.
